name: brightloop
description: Brightloop Subscription Management System: React frontend (client/) and Express + Postgres backend (server/)

scripts.setup: node scripts/init-env.mjs && npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run db:setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
